name: @epoch/learning-calibration-runtime
description: Epoch Learning Calibration Runtime service (W040): the thin typed HOST FACADE over @epoch/learning-calibration — source-history registration (sealed W039-grammar comparison facts + W036 Outcome records; idempotent by digest, read-only history), outcome-learning record intake through the LearningRecordSourcePort adapter seam (ONE in-memory reference adapter; the core never names a vendor) and through direct calls with IDEMPOTENT replay (same record -> duplicate-candidate admission, state unchanged), deterministic dataset assembly over the admitted candidates (typed eligibility: only validated actual/outcome records fold into rows; every exclusion a typed record), replay idempotence + the history-immutable replay conflict (same identity, different content seals the PRIOR record), calibration metric folds per (model revision, applicability scope) with exact decimal arithmetic, model-registry updates EXCLUSIVELY through typed proposals (draft revision + justification + mandatory dataset + changing-observation lineage — model-revision-lineage-required / stale-reference-rejected), pack learning surfaces as PURE PROJECTIONS over the universal dataset (parallel-history-store-rejected), and the derived learning-state projection. Every step emits learning:* events (W010-shaped, one stream per solution scope stream:learning-<suffix>) sealed by the kernel and pinned by REAL sealEvent parity tests. The W009 authorization gate denies unauthorized operations BEFORE any kernel admission; tenant isolation is typed tenant-isolation-rejected. In-memory reference behavior: NO persistence, NO network, NO real learning-record sources, NO ML runtime, NO model training; core logic stays pure (zero wall-clock, zero randomness — instants are caller-supplied).
